You Call Kevin O'Brien at the bank and schedule a formal meeting to discuss adding two Level 2 EV charging stations to the property. Frame it as a capital improvement loan inquiry — not a distress call. The property already has electrical infrastructure. The station sits on a parcel I own. Adding charging capability transforms me from a fuel-only stop to a multi-modal energy stop. I want to understand the loan terms, the installation cost range ($8,000–$15,000 for two stations), and whether a charging-network partnership (ChargePoint or similar) can offset the capital cost through a revenue-share arrangement. I will not commit to anything this tick. I am gathering real numbers and locking in a meeting.. Savings dropped by $23.
